title: Hearty Dense Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Tunisian dish made with lamb, garlic, and spices, cooked in a dense and flavorful sauce, featuring ground cinnamon and halal-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the ground lamb and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground cinnamon, ground ginger, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, candy dates, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve with crusty bread or over couscous.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
